H4.evidence: No e-mail, scheduler or overdue concept anywhere in src/; IMPLEMENTATION.md lists no report feature

H7.evidence: Single process, one SQLite file, no framework or cache layer; IMPLEMENTATION.md: 'expected volume is a few thousand records a year'

H8.evidence: Whole stack is JavaScript/Node: package.json '"start": "node src/server.js"', ES modules in public/, contradicting the Python-only maintainer constraint

H11.evidence: No deposit, fine or payment fields or code; domain.js ACTIONS = ['out','in'] only

notes: Clean, well-documented and well-tested Node.js code with a solid offline outbox, idempotent sync and CSV export, but it is written in JavaScript, which a Python-only volunteer cannot maintain, and it was never run here (pytest is missing and the project uses node --test).
